observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation console with the PlayStation logo on the front, plus a white DualSense-style controller and a power/AV cable bundle.
Photo 0 controller appears to be a DualSense (white body, black sticks/buttons, PlayStation button area visible).
Photo 1 shows the console from the side/front with the controller in front; no game disc is visible in either photo.
No model revision (disc vs digital) is clearly readable from the photos.
No FIFA disc, HDMI cable, or other accessories are clearly shown/identifiable in the photos.

read_from: photo 0 (PlayStation logo and PS5-style console shape; controller matches DualSense look)

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a PS5-style white console and a matching white controller.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game.
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc (or any disc) is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
Cables are visible, but specific accessories (e.g., HDMI, extra controller, headset, FIFA case) are not clearly shown.

risks.risk: Console may be the Digital Edition (no disc drive) or may not read discs, which would make the FIFA disc claim unusable.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc drive area (or the front panel) showing whether it has a disc slot, plus a short video of inserting a disc and the game starting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS5 with disc functionality not guaranteed (worst case: treat as not suitable for FIFA disc).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (may have faults, overheating, or controller issues).
risks.proof: Video clip showing the console fully booting to the home screen and the controller working (moving cursor + button presses).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possible faults (worst case: treat as needs testing).

risks.risk: Accessories list may be incomplete (only some cables included; HDMI/charging dock/extra items may be missing).
risks.proof: A single photo laid out showing every included item with labels (HDMI, power cable, controller charging/USB cable, any headset, FIFA disc and case).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + 1 controller + minimal cables only.

risks.risk: Controller authenticity/condition is unknown (could be a non-original or worn controller).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the controller model/serial label on the back and a video showing all buttons and analog sticks responding correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Show whether it is disc-capable: clear photo of the front disc slot (if present) and a short video inserting a disc and launching it.
Video of full boot to PS home screen and controller input working.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (including HDMI and FIFA disc + case if claimed).
Close-up of controller back label/serial and a quick button/stick test video.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5-style console and a controller, but they do not prove disc-drive capability or the FIFA disc/accessories claim. Without that, the worst-case pricing depends on whether discs work and what’s actually included.
